_how_to_edit: Reference data for the site: where to buy each kind of thing, rebates with end dates, the yearly sales calendar, big-buy watch list and store coupon rules. Sources: Better Deals project (outdoor-firearms-deals.md, master-deal-plan.md, store-directory.md) and workbook tabs (Yearly sales, Outdoor & firearms, Gear & Black Friday, Stores), Nov 2026. Calendar dates are typical patterns: confirm each year.

where_to_buy.name: Ammo
where_to_buy.tip: Search AmmoSeek first: prices vary $0.05–0.10 a round between stores ($50–100 on 1,000 rounds). Then check rebates. Store coupons usually exclude ammo, so rebates and points are the savings.

where_to_buy.name: Guns
where_to_buy.tip: Compare on Gun.deals, check the manufacturer rebate, and add shipping + the FFL transfer fee at Vance's before comparing online with in-store.

stores.best_for: AR-15s, PSA pistols; biggest Black Friday sale (~58% off)

where_to_buy.name: Skincare (serums, sunscreen, brand names)
where_to_buy.tip: Drugstore basics (moisturizer, soap) are usually cheapest through CVS/Walgreens rewards: see your weekly deals. Serums and sunscreen: wait for Ulta 21 Days, The Ordinary sale or Black Friday. With tretinoin: no benzoyl peroxide or other retinoids.

where_to_buy.tip: Set Keepa or CamelCamelCamel alerts at your target. Stack: card offer → one cash-back portal → student discount → Citi card. Don't use the Amazon account signed in as Gustavo.

store_rules.counts: Pretax total after all discounts; clearance counts
store_rules.stack: One DG digital coupon per item + Ibotta
store_rules.watch: Can't combine with other DG storewide $2/$3/$5 coupons. Excludes milk, tobacco, alcohol, gift cards, propane. Plan max 5 coupons per transaction. DG coupons can't be unclipped.
store_rules.fillers: Clearance (orange tags), toilet paper, dish soap, detergent, bar soap, toothpaste

store_rules.goal: Spend $X, get $Y ExtraBucks; $X off $Y ExtraCare coupons
store_rules.counts: ExtraBucks deals use price before coupons
store_rules.stack: One CVS coupon + one manufacturer coupon per item
store_rules.watch: ExtraBucks can't exceed your total after coupons. Usually once per household per deal. Separate transactions so new ExtraBucks print.
store_rules.fillers: CVS Health brand, toothpaste, deodorant, dish soap, tissues

store_rules.goal: Register Rewards (buy X, get $Y); $X off $Y coupons
store_rules.stack: One Walgreens coupon + one manufacturer coupon per item
store_rules.watch: Register Rewards can't pay for the same deal. Items ≥ coupons + rewards (add a cheap filler). Rewards print in store only.
store_rules.fillers: Walgreens brand, toothpaste, candy bar or gum

store_rules.goal: Buy 5 save $X mix-and-match; digital coupons; fuel points
store_rules.counts: Each promo item counts 1 toward the 5
store_rules.stack: One manufacturer coupon per item + Kroger digital deal
store_rules.watch: Digital coupons often one use per account. Clip before checkout; use your card or phone number.
store_rules.fillers: Any item in the same mix-and-match

store_rules.goal: Target Circle offers; buy $X get a $Y gift card
store_rules.stack: One Circle offer + one manufacturer coupon per item + Ibotta
store_rules.watch: Gift card deals often exclude items bought with other promos. Circle Week has the deepest discounts.
Scan clearance in the app: the system price can be lower than the tag. Walmart+ free shipping, $35 delivery minimum.

store_rules.stack: Instant Savings + Ibotta; Plus = 2% Sam's Cash
store_rules.watch: Free shipping with Plus; club delivery $50 minimum.
